title: ICSE CLASS 4 — English | Tenses

subject: icse4-english

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form to complete the sentence: The sun always _________ in the east.

options.explanation: This is the base form of the verb and does not match the subject 'sun'.
This is the simple past tense and does not fit the context of a habitual action.
This is the correct simple present tense form for the singular subject 'sun'.
This is the simple future tense and does not match the context of a habitual action.

questions.explanation: The sentence describes a universal truth or habitual action, requiring the simple present tense. For a singular subject ('sun'), the verb takes an '-s'.
questions.hint: Think about the tense used for general truths or repeated actions.
questions.subject: icse4-english

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb: My grandmother _________ me a story last night.

questions.question: **Case-Based Question:** Read the short passage about Maya: 'Maya loves to draw. Every Sunday, she sits and draws for hours. Last Sunday, she drew a beautiful landscape. options.text: Maya is drawing her pet cat.
options.explanation: This describes an action happening now or in the future, not last Sunday.
This correctly describes Maya's action last Sunday using the simple past tense.

options.text: She plans to draw a picture of her pet cat.
options.explanation: This describes a future action, not an action that happened last Sunday.

questions.explanation: The question asks for Maya's action 'last Sunday'. The passage states, 'Last Sunday, she drew a beautiful landscape,' which is correctly reflected in option C, using the simple past tense.
questions.hint: Focus on the time phrase 'last Sunday' to identify the correct action.
